description: This file contains utility functions for making API requests, including GET, POST, and generic request functions, along with error normalization and URL building logic.

methods.name: normalizeError(err)
methods.description: Normalizes various error types into a consistent error object with message and status.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL from a base URL and a relative path, handling slashes.

methods.name: processResponse(res)
methods.description: Processes the fetch response, handles JSON parsing and error conditions.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request; supports mock data fallback if base URL isn't set.

methods.name: post(path, data, { headers = {}, signal, mockData = { ok: true } } = {})
methods.description: Performs a POST request with JSON data; supports mock fallback.

methods.name: request(path, { method = 'GET', headers = {}, body, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs a generic fetch request; recommends using get/post for common use cases.

ctags.name: post
ctags.pattern: /^export async function post(path, data, { headers = {}, signal, mockData = { ok: true } } = {}) {$/
ctags.signature: (path, data, { headers = {}, signal, mockData = { ok: true } } = {})

ctags.name: request
ctags.pattern: /^export async function request(path, { method = 'GET', headers = {}, body, signal } = {}) {$/
